name: Dragon Pillar
description: A 10-foot-tall wooden pole topped by a wooden carving of Dahak's head. Each dragon pillar's head has been treated with something to give it a distinct color, as indicated in the specific encounter, but regardless of color, plumes of smoke waft up from the mouth.
disable: DC 26 Athletics (expert) to push the pillar over, or DC 26 Thievery (expert) on the pillar to erase the magic runes that power it, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 22) to dispel the pillar's magic.
reset: The dragon pillar deactivates and resets as soon as it perceives no appropriate targets in range.
routine: (1 action) On its initiative, the dragon pillar fires an eye beam at the closest target within 120 feet.

generalAbilities.name: Recognize Ally
generalAbilities.description: A dragon pillar can see through its empty eye sockets, and it can recognize Cinderclaws and their allies. A character disguised as a Cinderclaw can trick a dragon pillar into perceiving it as a Cinderclaw ally by using Deception to Impersonate. A dragon pillar always uses Perception for initiative.

generalAbilities.name: Dragon Pillar Glance
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The dragon pillar sees a creature within 120 feet who isn't a recognized Cinderclaw or Cinderclaw ally.

Effect The dragon pillar makes an eye beam Strike against the triggering creature, then rolls initiative.

generalAbilities.name: Black Eye Beam
generalAbilities.description:
DC 24 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Blinded for 1 round.

Failure The target is blinded for 1 hour.

Critical Failure The target is blinded for 24 hours.

generalAbilities.name: Blue Eye Beam
generalAbilities.description:
DC 24 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Petrified for 1 round.

Failure The target is petrified for 1 hour.

Critical Failure The target is petrified permanently.

generalAbilities.name: Green Eye Beam
generalAbilities.description: 6d6 Poison Damage damage (Basic DC 24 Reflex Saving Throw save.)

generalAbilities.name: Indigo Eye Beam
generalAbilities.description:
DC 24 Will Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Slowed 1 for 1 round.

Failure The target is Confused for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is controlled by the dragon pillar and remains within 60 feet of it at all times, defending the dragon pillar from all non-Cinderclaws. While a target is controlled, it is treated as a Cinderclaw ally by the dragon pillar. The dragon pillar can control up to 3 targets at a time; any targets in excess who critically fail this saving throw are instead confused for 1d4+1 rounds. A controlled creature can attempt a new Will save once every 24 hours to escape control, but doing so automatically causes the dragon pillar to attack it with a new eye beam to attempt to re-establish control. The control ends if the pillar is destroyed.

generalAbilities.name: Yellow Eye Beam
generalAbilities.description: 6d6 Electricity Damage damage (Basic DC 24 Reflex Saving Throw save.)

generalAbilities.name: Orange Eye Beam
generalAbilities.description: 6d6 Acid Damage damage (Basic DC 24 Reflex Saving Throw save.)

generalAbilities.name: Red Eye Beam
generalAbilities.description: 6d6 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 24 Reflex Saving Throw save.)

generalAbilities.name: Violet Eye Beam
generalAbilities.description:
DC 24 Will Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Stunned 1.

Failure The target is Stunned 3.

Critical Failure The target is Stunned 7.
